title: Threatens to block your account or card
why: Scammers invent a deadline so you act before thinking. A real bank sends you a letter and lets you visit a branch.
examples: Your account will be suspended within 24 hours. Click the link to avoid closure: https://sbi-help.xyz
Your SIM is going to be blocked tonight. Call 9876543210 to avoid this.
safe: Your card ending 4821 has been blocked as per your request.
